$note: Written for whoever is sourcing pictures, not for the pipeline. The reel renders without any of these: every line here is either drawn procedurally or stated in type, and each entry says which. BLOCKING means the line is about something type cannot depict and no drawing covers it.

wanted.says: In 1901 sponge divers off Antikythera found a wreck full of bronze.
wanted.subject: quantity
wanted.described: dark green water over a rocky seabed
wanted.purpose: illustrate the claim the line makes
wanted.composition: the subject clear of clutter, with room to crop to 9:16
wanted.constraints: must depict the thing the line names
wanted.substitutes: none — a near miss is a rejection
wanted.reject: anything that is not the subject; approximation is what this manifest exists to prevent

wanted.says: Among the statues lay a lump of corroded metal the size of a book.
wanted.subject: material
wanted.purpose: show the substance itself at a scale where its structure is visible
wanted.composition: macro or section; the structure is the subject, not the object it came from
wanted.constraints: the actual material named; a sample of the same class only if labelled
wanted.substitutes: a published micrograph or core sample photograph with its source credited
wanted.reject: a generic texture, a rendered material, anything where the structure cannot be seen

wanted.says: It sat in a museum drawer for fifty years before anyone looked inside.
wanted.subject: elapsed
wanted.described: rows of wooden museum storage drawers
wanted.purpose: a dated document or place that fixes the span in something real
wanted.composition: the document or the place, legible
wanted.substitutes: a contemporaneous document of the same kind

wanted.says: X-rays found thirty gears, cut by hand, meshing.

wanted.constraints: the actual mechanism or a documented reconstruction of it
